places.name: Sighisoara Citadel (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Sighisoara Citadel is a well-preserved medieval fortress and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offering a glimpse into Romania’s history.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring cobblestone streets.

places.name: Clock Tower Museum
places.ai_summary: The Clock Tower Museum offers panoramic views of Sighisoara and exhibits on the town’s history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the citadel.

places.name: Vlad the Impaler’s Birth House
places.ai_summary: Visit the birthplace of Vlad the Impaler, the historical figure who inspired Dracula, located in the heart of Sighisoara.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal variations in hours.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Citadel for a full historical experience.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Attend a service for a unique cultural experience.

places.ai_summary: A historic covered stairway with 175 steps, leading up to the Church on the Hill, offering a unique architectural experience.

opening_hours.notes: Well-lit and safe at night.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos from the top.
